title: On-call: rota, escalation, handover and compensation

videos.script: The rota says the pager is shared five ways. One week each, in turn, and round again. {{rota}} The pager says something else. Over a quarter, Rafa was woken fifty-four times. Caio, six. {{pager}} Not because Rafa's weeks were worse. Because every time a page touched the card code, whoever held the pager called Rafa. {{called}} That is the right thing to do during an incident, and the wrong thing to do for three months. {{months}} This lesson is about carrying the pager in a way people can keep doing. {{keep}} How a rota is built, and how big it has to be. How escalation works, up and across. What a handover note carries. What the pager should be paid, including what Brazilian law says. {{paid}} And the three numbers that tell you, before anybody resigns, that the load has landed on the wrong person. {{numbers}}
